beats.text: Almost all of your stress comes from one mistake.
Epictetus — born a slave, who became a philosopher — named it two thousand years ago.
Of things, some are in our power, but others are not.
In your power: your judgements, your choices, what you do next.
Not in your power: your body, your reputation, other people, the past.
Spend your life fighting the second list, and you will never rest.
Guard the first. Let go of the rest. That is the whole of freedom.

source_note: Quote: Epictetus, Discourses I.1, trans. George Long (public domain).
